caption:
Ship a custom font in your machine coding round, test it on slow 4G, and the headings stay blank while everything else has loaded.

Look at the card. Without font-display, most browsers hide text that uses a web font for up to about 3 seconds while the font downloads. That's FOIT (flash of invisible text).

font-display: swap shows the text in a fallback font right away, then swaps when the font arrives. If you'd rather avoid the swap jump, optional uses the web font only if it arrives almost immediately.

Google Fonts adds &display=swap to its CSS links for exactly this reason.

Source: MDN, @font-face font-display.
